subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public `before_tool_call` policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose, and which provenance/session facts are safe for ordinary plugins versus trusted policy plugins?
rationale: This would define a public Plugin SDK security-policy surface; automation cannot choose the taxonomy, redaction boundary, or trust-tier visibility without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define Unified Policy Facts
options.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it across core, trusted policies, plugin hooks, docs, and API baselines.

options.title: Land Narrow Slices First
options.body: Accept narrower work such as external-content provenance while keeping this issue open for broader action and input provenance design.

options.title: Defer Hook Enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape until capability descriptors, Security Matrix, and provenance visibility are settled together.

recommendation.title: Define Unified Policy Facts
recommendation.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it across core, trusted policies, plugin hooks, docs, and API baselines.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged generic host-hook work is the closest public SDK seam for a before_tool_call policy-facts decision.
